title: radiation.tool_registry/2
description: Bounded tool contract (5500-closure Step 2): every runnable RADIATION tool with entry, IO schema refs, effects, mutation scope, approval class, data classes, network, credentials, idempotency, timeout, cap mapping, test command, observability. Executed by scripts/tool_registry_check.py via the ONE schema executor; semantic contradictions are code-level rules there. Local and non-authorizing: a registry entry grants nothing.

entrypoint.description: repo-relative path; containment is re-enforced as a code-level rule (defense in depth)

mutation_scope.description: highest-persistence write the tool may produce: none=no writes; temporary=auto-cleaned temp only; ignored_local=gitignored working areas; evidence_draft=draft evidence; tracked_derived=regenerates tracked files from records; canonical_none=may stage canonical-adjacent drafts, mutates no canonical bytes itself (canonical change is only ever the Commander's motor act)

approval.description: the authority class the tool's effects rest on; an assertion RECORDS an order, it never IS authorization

cap_mapping.description: task ids of cap records (evidence/tasks/<TID>/artifacts/cap_record_build.json) whose seal covers this tool's gate; existence is a code-level rule
